name: Camp Sloane YMCA Day Camp
description_short: A day camp for children entering grades K-6, run 8:45am-4:45pm at Camp Sloane YMCA in Lakeville, CT. Campers are grouped by rising grade and do sports, arts and crafts, boating, adventure activities and daily swim lessons.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim lessons every day. Boating is one of the activities.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page says 'four 2-week sessions' in one place and 'four 4-week sessions' in another. The 2027 dates show Sessions A-D are two weeks each, so '4-week' looks like a typo.

Pricing has tiers you pick yourself. Session prices shown are the Tier 1 full-cost rate ($1085 for 2 weeks, $545 for 1 week). Tier 2 is $1010/$505, Tier 3 is $935/$465, and Tier 4 is financial aid at a variable rate.
Extra fees not in the session price: horseback riding $275/week, Before Care $150/session, After Care $125/session (email info@campsloane.org to add care).
unknowns: Age range in years (the page gives grades only)
Whether the camp is ACA accredited
When registration opens and how many spots are left in each session
